resources.string: Yeh service sirf aapke kehne par Home/Back dabane, screen par dikhe button par click karne aur scroll karne ke liye hai. Yeh password wale fields ko nahi chhoti aur screen ka data store ya kahin bheji nahi karti.

PUJA AI v1.0 (MVP)

✅ KYA KAAM KARTA HAI
• Gemini se chat (streaming) + local chat history
• Hindi/Hinglish voice: SpeechRecognizer + TextToSpeech
• App kholna, website/YouTube, YouTube search
• Alarm (Clock app), Calendar event, Settings pages
• Task list aur approved memory (aap dekh/delete kar sakte ho)
• File padhna/save karna (aap file chunte ho - SAF)
• Accessibility se Home/Back/click/scroll (aapke enable karne par)
• Call/SMS: sirf dialer ya compose screen khulti hai

🚧 IMPLEMENT NAHI HUA
• Wake word (Puja bolte hi sunna) - reliable nahi hota, isliye nahi banaya
• Background mic service
• Notification access
• Payments, passwords, OTP wale kaam (jaan-bujhkar band)

🔐 SECURITY
• API key sirf aapke phone me app-private storage me rehti hai.
• APK me key daalna unsafe hai - koi bhi nikaal sakta hai. Public app ke liye apna backend proxy banao.
• Yeh AI hai, insaan nahi. Galat jawab de sakta hai - zaroori cheezein khud check karo.

🛠️ TROUBLESHOOTING
• API key galat: Settings me key dobara paste karo (aistudio.google.com/apikey).
• Quota: thodi der ruko ya doosra model try karo.
• Voice kaam nahi kar rahi: Mic permission do, Google app/Speech Services update karo.
• Hindi awaaz nahi aa rahi: Phone Settings > Text-to-speech > Hindi voice data download karo.
• App nahi khul raha: app ka naam English me bolo (jaise WhatsApp kholo).
• Accessibility band ho jaye: Settings > Accessibility > PUJA AI Automation ko dobara ON karo.
